description: CoreDNS request rate, latency, errors and cache on AKS (Azure managed Prometheus, coredns target enabled)

panels.title: CoreDNS Pods
panels.description: CoreDNS instances reporting metrics

panels.title: Request Rate
panels.description: DNS queries per second

panels.title: P99 Latency
panels.description: 99th percentile time to answer a query (cache + upstream)

panels.title: SERVFAIL %
panels.description: Queries CoreDNS could not answer, usually an upstream DNS problem

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (cluster) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", rcode=~"SERVFAIL"}[5m])) / sum by (cluster) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"}[5m]))

panels.title: Cache Hit Ratio
panels.description: Share of queries answered from the CoreDNS cache

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (cluster) (rate(coredns_cache_hits_total{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) / (sum by (cluster) (rate(coredns_cache_hits_total{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) + sum by (cluster) (rate(coredns_cache_misses_total{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"}[5m])))

panels.title: Panics (time range)
panels.description: CoreDNS panics. Should always be 0.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster) (increase(coredns_panics_total{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) or count by (cluster) (coredns_build_info{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"}) * 0

panels.title: Requests by Record Type
panels.description: A, AAAA, SRV, PTR… A high AAAA rate on an IPv4-only cluster is wasted lookups.

panels.title: Requests by Protocol
panels.description: UDP vs TCP. TCP is used for large responses and retries after truncation.

panels.title: Requests per CoreDNS Pod
panels.description: Load should be roughly even across pods

panels.title: Requests by Zone
panels.description: Cluster-internal (cluster.local) vs everything else (".")

panels.title: Upstream (Forward) Request Rate
panels.description: Queries CoreDNS forwards to the upstream resolver (Azure DNS 168.63.129.16 by default)

panels.title: Response Latency Percentiles
panels.description: P50 / P95 / P99 for all queries

panels.title: Upstream (Forward) Latency P99
panels.description: Time the upstream resolver takes. If this is high, overall latency follows.

panels.title: Response Latency Distribution
panels.description: How query latencies are spread over time. Most should sit in the lowest buckets (cache hits).

panels.title: Responses by Rcode
panels.description: NOERROR, NXDOMAIN, SERVFAIL, REFUSED… per second

panels.title: Error Rates %
panels.description: SERVFAIL and REFUSED are real failures. NXDOMAIN is mostly search-domain expansion (ndots:5) and is normal.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (cluster) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", rcode=~"SERVFAIL"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (cluster) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

100 * sum by (cluster) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", rcode=~"REFUSED"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (cluster) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

100 * sum by (cluster) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", rcode=~"NXDOMAIN"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (cluster) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Upstream & Plugin Errors
panels.description: Forwarder errors from the upstream resolver, failed upstream health checks, and panics

panels.title: Cache Hit Ratio %
panels.description: Hits / (hits + misses). Below ~50% means most queries go upstream.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (cluster, instance) (rate(coredns_cache_hits_total{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (cluster, instance) (rate(coredns_cache_hits_total{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (cluster, instance) (rate(coredns_cache_misses_total{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Cache Hits vs Misses
panels.description: success = positive answers cached, denial = negative (NXDOMAIN/NODATA) answers cached

panels.title: Cache Entries
panels.description: Number of cached records per type. Hitting the cache size limit lowers the hit ratio.

title: CoreDNS – AKS
